msg: Keep an eye on the colour of the gnomes. Different colours work as a pair; red and purple, brown and green. One high, one low in term of points. This seems to change at points during the game, so i quite often stayed with one colour or one type of gnome until the amount of points dipped. Be patient and if you have a run of low scores then vary the strategy you are using until you hit upon a run of high points.
